scope: Domestic leagues only (no European prices are cached). Offers: Home win, Away win and the main AH line, both sides, the only prices the files carry (no plus lines, alternate lines or double chance), so cagey-safe bets (no-loss >= 0.75) are rare and short-priced; odds (1.15, 2.00]; cost 0. Research view C or C6 (value list, p_r, labels and the flag), cagey view D, Pinnacle margin-free reference = binary margin-free 1X2 for wins and AH +/-0.5, else M (the live master's reference and the missing-evidence fallback). The live master is always built on C's value list, as live; the previous rule is PR #171's (master_rule_v1) on the same offers. Slate = calendar week, 15-match target. Locked: no holdout match is read. Development deciding, validation a check, retrospective (synthetic Pinnacle-like prices from Bet365) a diagnostic. Bets by gap check and flagged offers = every pooled offer in that category (up to four per match); observed no-loss = return >= 0.
